description: React component for providing UI controls to confirm and download a PDF file after a background job completes.

methods.name: DownloadPanel({ jobId, jobStatus })
methods.description: React functional component handling user interactions for confirming and downloading a PDF based on job status.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered when the user clicks the confirm button, calling API to confirm job completion.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered when the user clicks the download button, handling the download process of the PDF blob.
